name: tests-75pct-strix-run-artifact-integrity-and-degraded-f088
instr:
Add local artifact integrity records, verification, recovery, and viewer/terminal summaries. Preserve existing behavior.

Build manifests from iterable (path, required, role) entries. Normalize run-relative paths; reject parent or absolute escapes with ValueError. Record each file's byte size, SHA-256 digest, required flag, and supplied role. Generation identity is independent of entry order and changes when declared content changes; unchanged files retain their digests.

Completed persistence must verify every emitted artifact except the integrity metadata file itself. Finding updates publish a new generation visible unchanged in the viewer. Empty clean persistence replaces stale SARIF with empty results. Optional SARIF/coverage writer failures leave findings/run data readable, report degraded status, and identify findings.sarif/coverage.json.

Modified primary evidence is corrupt; unaffected evidence remains verified. Missing optional artifacts degrade verification; missing required artifacts have a different outcome. Malformed metadata reports its path and an outcome other than verified, legacy, or degraded. Unmanifested directories remain legacy, readable, repeatable, and unchanged by offline verification.

Recovery regenerates missing vulnerabilities.json from declared finding evidence, reports corrupt primary evidence as unrecoverable, leaves unrelated files unchanged, excludes undeclared findings, and keeps legacy runs legacy.

Viewer run/history summaries expose integ
